FeatureConfig.description: Configuration for a single technical indicator/feature.

source.description: Input price series (e.g., open, high, low, close, hl2).
source.title: Source

source_ref.description: Reference another feature as input series.
source_ref.title: Source Ref

FeatureConfig.title: FeatureConfig

description:
Defines the configuration for a single run of the trading platform.
This object will be snapshotted into the run directory for reproducibility.

user_id.description: Identifier for the user or owner of the run.
user_id.title: User Id

run_seed.description: Seed for all random number generators.
run_seed.title: Run Seed

runs_dir.description: The root directory where run artifacts are stored.
runs_dir.title: Runs Dir

log_level.description: The logging level for the run.
log_level.title: Log Level

instrument_definitions.description: Per-symbol instrument metadata snapshot included in briefs.
instrument_definitions.title: Instrument Definitions

cost_model.description: Global cost model snapshot (e.g., spread/commission/slippage settings).
cost_model.title: Cost Model

fill_policy.description: Fill policy snapshot (e.g., market, next-bar, bar-mid, etc.).
fill_policy.title: Fill Policy

monte_carlo.description: Monte Carlo placeholder (e.g., seed, n_paths) to echo into brief.
monte_carlo.title: Monte Carlo

walk_forward.description: Walk-forward placeholder (e.g., splits metadata) to echo into brief.
walk_forward.title: Walk Forward

parameter_search.description: Parameter search config/results (e.g., grid, random, top result) to include in brief.
parameter_search.title: Parameter Search

rmm_config.description: Regime Market Manager configuration, if any.
rmm_config.title: Rmm Config

warmup_bars.description: Number of initial bars to ignore for entries (indicator warm-up).
warmup_bars.title: Warmup Bars

entry_window_bars.description: Number of bars after a signal transition during which entry attempts are allowed. 0 = only on exact transition bar (event-based), >0 = allow RMM-blocked entries to execute if unblocked within window, -1 = infinite (always try when signal is active, state-based).
entry_window_bars.title: Entry Window Bars

min_hold_bars.description: Minimum number of bars a position must be held before any exit (REM or signal-based) is allowed. Prevents premature exits.
min_hold_bars.title: Min Hold Bars

blackout_events.description: Event-based blackout windows with start/end datetimes and optional metadata.
blackout_events.title: Blackout Events

initial_cash.description: The starting cash for the portfolio.
initial_cash.title: Initial Cash

position_size.description: Fixed trade size (units/contracts/shares) used when opening a position.
position_size.title: Position Size

allow_flip_on_bar.description: If True, allows closing a position and opening a new one on the same bar.
allow_flip_on_bar.title: Allow Flip On Bar

execution_model.description: Execution model for entries and exits. 'current_bar_close' executes trades immediately at the signal bar's close price (unrealistic, but useful for rapid prototyping). 'next_bar_open' defers execution to the next bar's open price (realistic, industry standard, matches TradingView behavior). For golden validation testing, always use 'next_bar_open'. See docs/architecture/execution_model.md for details.
execution_model.title: Execution Model

exit_tie_break.description: Exit tie-break policy when both stop-loss and take-profit are hit on the same bar. 'stop_then_tp' (default) checks stop-loss first, 'tp_then_stop' checks take-profit first. This matters for intra-bar exits where both levels are breached.
exit_tie_break.title: Exit Tie Break

daily_loss_cap.description: Portfolio-level daily loss cap in base currency.
daily_loss_cap.title: Daily Loss Cap

data_request.description: Data request specification (symbol, timeframe, start, end).
data_request.title: Data Request

instrument.description: Instrument definition for the run (auto-populated from data_request if omitted).
instrument.title: Instrument

counterfactual_mode.description: How to compute counterfactuals for skipped entries: 'fast' uses a vectorized hold-to-end approximation; 'exact' re-simulates bar-by-bar with REM.
counterfactual_mode.title: Counterfactual Mode

post_exit_analysis.description: Post-exit price tracking configuration for exit efficiency analysis. Example: {'enabled': True, 'horizons': [10, 20, 50]}
post_exit_analysis.title: Post Exit Analysis

contextual_features.description: A list of indicators to compute for context, even if not used in strategy rules.
contextual_features.title: Contextual Features

title: RunConfig
